statement: Let T be a Scheme with [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace T], let ℓ : ℕ with [Fact ℓ.Prime], and let M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology T) Ab.{u + 1}) (padicAlgClRingObj T ℓ). Let i : Y ⟶ T be a closed immersion with [IsClosedImmersion i] and [Nonempty Y]. Let j : U ⟶ Y be an open immersion and k : Z ⟶ Y a closed immersion, with [IsOpenImmersion j] and [IsClosedImmersion k], and assume hcover : Set.range j ∪ Set.range k = Set.univ and hdisj : Disjoint (Set.range j) (Set.range k). Given finite coefficient fields EU and EZ, module objects PU on U and PZ on Z over their finite coefficient rings, constructibility hypotheses hPU and hPZ for PU and PZ, and Nonempty scalar-extension isomorphisms eU and eZ identifying those objects with the pullbacks of M along j ≫ i and k ≫ i, there exist a finite coefficient field E and a module object P on Y over padicSubfieldRingObj Y ℓ E such that P is constructible and its scalar extension is Nonempty isomorphic to (CondensedRing.upperStar (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj ℓ) i).obj M. This is exactly the complete Lean signature of glue_nonempty_support_open_closed_models, including every immersion instance, object, hypothesis and witness.

proof.text: Enlarge EU and EZ to a finite compositum and extend both models. Apply open/closed localization to express the pullback of M as an extension of the closed direct image by the open extension by zero. Use tensor-restriction adjunction, exactness and filtered-colimit continuity to identify scalar extensions of the outer terms. Descend the localization extension class by Ext-continuity to a finite stage, realize it by extension classification, and use Serre closure to obtain the constructible middle term whose scalar extension is the desired pullback.
